scheme_name: H.P. Swaran Jayanti Middle Merit Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Student must be a regular student in a Government School of Himachal Pradesh
Student must continue studying in the same Government School without repeating any class
Student must have at least 75% attendance during the session, except in genuine medical cases verified by a Medical Board
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹4000 per month in class 6, ₹5000 per month in class 7, and ₹6000 per month in class 8, each paid for 12 months.
